description: This file contains test cases for the RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) process using Bedrock Knowledge Base within a Python project. It includes environment setup checks, configuration of Bedrock-specific options, and a test method for querying Bedrock's knowledge base, leveraging boto3 for AWS interactions.

classes.name: TestRAGBedrock
classes.description: Test class for RAG Ingest with Bedrock Knowledge Base, inheriting from BaseRAGTest to implement specific test scenarios and environment checks related to Bedrock.

methods.name: check_env_vars(self)
methods.description: Pytest fixture that checks for required AWS environment variables before executing tests; skips tests if credentials are missing.

methods.name: RAGIngestOptions get_base_ingest_options(self)
methods.description: Returns Bedrock-specific ingest options, either using an existing knowledge base ID or set to auto-create if none is provided via environment variable.

methods.name: Optional[Dict[str,Any]] query_vector_store( self, vector_store_id: str, query: str, )
methods.description: Asynchronously queries the Bedrock knowledge base using boto3; retrieves results matching the query and performs basic validation.
